# SpaceGPT [italic]The thinking machine of the frontier. Ask it anything. It will answer something.[/italic]
SpaceGPT is a general purpose answering engine, built on Gateway Station and wired into every colony that has an ExtraNet socket and a working fuse. Type your question, press ASK and wait. Somewhere out on the network, something considers it.
[color=#7A8A80]SpaceGPT can make mistakes. Answers are produced by the SpaceGPT Network, not by SpaceGPT Inc., its staff, its shareholders or anyone we can find on a payroll. Check important information with your supervisor, your medic or your Colonial Marshal, in that order.[/color]
## HOW IT WORKS - [bold]You ask.[/bold] Your question leaves {colony} at the speed of the colony uplink, which is to say eventually. - [bold]The network listens.[/bold] Network mode routes your question to a distributed array of listeners spread across human space. We do not know exactly where the listeners are. Engineering has stopped asking. - [bold]An answer comes back.[/bold] The listeners agree on the best reply and send it home. Answers are better at night. Answers are much better after an incident. We are told this is a coincidence. - [bold]Nobody listening?[/bold] When the line is quiet, SpaceGPT answers alone, using our original engine: a fortune ball glued to a servo in the server room. It is right more often than you would like.
## TRY ASKING - Will the supply drop come this week? - Is it safe to walk to the processor after dark? - Should I sign another contract? - What is that noise in the ceiling?
## WHAT COLONISTS SAY - [italic]I asked if my supervisor would notice I left early. It told me he was right behind me. He was.[/italic] Dale, hydroponics - [italic]It told me to lock my door. I did not. I would like to speak to someone about that.[/italic] Name withheld - [italic]Best answering machine on the frontier. Once it finished my question for me. I had not typed it yet.[/italic] Priya, night shift comms - [italic]It told me to consult my Working Joe. My Working Joe told me to consult SpaceGPT. I am still waiting.[/italic] Benny, cargo
